shortDescription: Manage instances on the Linode Public Cloud

options.name: additional_disks
options.description: List of dictionaries for creating additional disks that are added to the Linode configuration settings. Dictionary takes Size, Label, Type. Size is in MB.

options.name: alert_bwin_enabled
options.description: Set status of bandwidth in alerts.

options.name: alert_bwin_threshold
options.description: Set threshold in MB of bandwidth in alerts.

options.name: alert_bwout_enabled
options.description: Set status of bandwidth out alerts.

options.name: alert_bwout_threshold
options.description: Set threshold in MB of bandwidth out alerts.

options.name: alert_bwquota_enabled
options.description: Set status of bandwidth quota alerts as percentage of network transfer quota.

options.name: alert_bwquota_threshold
options.description: Set threshold in MB of bandwidth quota alerts.

options.name: alert_cpu_enabled
options.description: Set status of receiving CPU usage alerts.

options.name: alert_cpu_threshold
options.description: Set percentage threshold for receiving CPU usage alerts. Each CPU core adds 100% to total.

options.name: alert_diskio_enabled
options.description: Set status of receiving disk IO alerts.

options.name: alert_diskio_threshold
options.description: Set threshold for average IO ops/sec over 2 hour period.

options.name: api_key
options.description: Linode API key. E(LINODE_API_KEY) environment variable can be used instead.

options.name: backupweeklyday
options.description: Day of the week to take backups.

options.name: backupwindow
options.description: The time window in which backups are taken.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: Datacenter to create an instance in (Linode Datacenter).

options.name: displaygroup
options.description: Add the instance to a Display Group in Linode Manager.

options.name: distribution
options.description: Distribution to use for the instance (Linode Distribution).

options.name: kernel_id
options.description: Kernel to use for the instance (Linode Kernel).

options.name: linode_id
options.description: Unique ID of a Linode server. This value is read-only in the sense that if you specify it on creation of a Linode it is not used. The Linode API generates these IDs and we can those generated value here to reference a Linode more specifically. This is useful for idempotency.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to give the instance (alphanumeric, dashes, underscore). To keep sanity on the Linode Web Console, name is prepended with C(LinodeID-).

options.name: password
options.description: Root password to apply to a new server (auto generated if missing).

options.name: payment_term
options.description: Payment term to use for the instance (payment term in months).

options.name: plan
options.description: Plan to use for the instance (Linode plan).

options.name: private_ip
options.description: Add private IPv4 address when Linode is created. Default is V(false).

options.name: ssh_pub_key
options.description: SSH public key applied to root user.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: swap
options.description: Swap size in MB.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the instance to be in state V(running) before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.

options.name: watchdog
options.description: Set status of Lassie watchdog.
